Throughout the year, AfOx support the exchange of ideas, research evidence, skills and experience to a multidisciplinary audience. The AfOx insakas are a platform to share ideas and knowledge about Africa-focused research with speakers from diverse and varied academic disciplines. FORA brought together researchers from Oxford and African partner institutions from multidisciplinary fields to share recent findings, ideas and solutions on a range of Africa-related issues.
